_README: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE CORPUS - NOT REAL FACT-CHECKS. Every record here is invented, uses a placeholder publisher name and an example.invalid URL, and is flagged with _synthetic:true. Its only purpose is to let the pipeline run and be demonstrated with no network. Passages from this file are labelled [SYNTHETIC SAMPLE] in the CLI and trigger a red warning banner in the dashboard, and retrieval_strength is halved for them. Real evidence comes from cache/claimreview.json, which tools/build_cache.py populates from the live Google Fact Check Tools API once an API key exists.
